courses.name: Intro to Programming
courses.syllabus:
CS101 Intro to Programming. Instructor: Dr. Ramos. Office hours: Tue/Thu 2-4pm, Room 210.

Grading: Quizzes 20%, Labs 40%, Midterm 15%, Final project 25%.

Late work: -10% per day, up to 3 days. After that, no credit unless you email the instructor before the deadline.

AI tools: You may use AI assistants to explain concepts and debug errors. You may not submit AI-written code as your own.

installing-python.title: Installing Python
installing-python.body: Download Python 3 from python.org. On Mac, run the installer, then open Terminal and type python3 --version to check it worked.

loops-lecture-notes.title: Loops lecture notes
loops-lecture-notes.body:
A for loop repeats code once for each item in a sequence: for i in range(5): print(i) prints 0 through 4.

A while loop repeats while a condition is true. A loop counter is a variable you update each time through the loop, like count = count + 1.

Common bug: forgetting to update the counter in a while loop causes an infinite loop.

assignments.name: Quiz 1
assignments.instructions: 10 multiple-choice questions on Python basics and installing Python.

assignments.name: Lab 1: Loops
assignments.instructions: Write a program that asks the user for a number n, then prints the sum of all numbers from 1 to n using a loop. Then extend it to print only the even numbers' sum. Submit your .py file.
